title: Group Anagrams
prompt: Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order.
constraints: Each string consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Two strings are anagrams if and only if their sorted characters match — that gives you a natural grouping key.
Use a hash map from the sorted-character key to a list of original strings that match it.
Return the map's values as your grouped lists.
